description: Answers "what is the moon phase today?", "when is the next full moon / new moon?". The Moon on a day in the asker's calendar: what the day is called (new moon, waxing crescent, first quarter and so on), how much of the disc is lit, its age, the next full and new moon, and the four main phases of that month, in local time. Computed with Meeus and checked against US Naval Observatory tables; useful for planning aurora watching.

date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, in the given time zone. Defaults to today there.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone of the person asking, such as Europe/Moscow or America/New_York. Local times and days use it. Defaults to UTC.

name: get_moon_phase

ageDays.description: Days since the last new moon.

at.description: The moment the illumination and age describe: now for today, local noon for another date. UTC.

date.description: The local calendar date described, YYYY-MM-DD.

illuminationPercent.description: The lit share of the disc, 0 to 100.

phase.description: What the day is called: the phase whose moment falls on it, or the crescent or gibbous moon after the last one.

phasesThisMonth.description: New moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter in the local calendar month of the date.

sources.description: Where the data comes from and on what terms.
